# schema-drift

> Detect schema drift between data batches: profile records into a stored JSON baseline and report added or removed columns, type changes, null rate jumps, new categories and range breaks Python package `trysac-schema-drift`, import name `schema_drift`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
